items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Art Tatum and all of the great musicians, Nat Cole, Eddie Beal Bill, another fine pianist, all -- everybody came there every night for these little private parties that he had for people.

ctx.x: And the man became like a father to me, a brother. And I stayed at his house, and this is where Art Tatum and all of the great musicians, Nat Cole, Eddie Beal Bill, another fine pianist, all -- everybody came there every night for these little private parties that he had for people.
